content:
# Shipment permissions and withdrawn-declaration quota

Scope: `source_bound_licenses` services. This is a synthetic commercial equipment permission contract. Quantities are whole shipment units; charges are integer USD minor units. A permit's available quantity is capacity_units minus used_units. Its status, exporter, material, destination and inclusive validity interval all apply at actual declaration acceptance.

A withdrawn declaration returns its confirmed quantity to its original permit. The original used quantity decreases; the permit's capacity, material scope, destinations and expiry do not change. A partial withdrawal restores only the actually confirmed quantity, rather than the whole original declaration. Restoring an expired permit's ledger quantity does not reissue it. Reinstated quantities cannot be transferred to another permit. The old declaration and its original use remain part of the historical record.

An arranged new permit becomes usable only when its issuance event posts the actual capacity and ISSUED status. Its recorded possible capacities are possibilities rather than a promise of the maximum. Scheduled stock becomes available at its recorded delivery event; supplier readiness metadata alone does not make it available before then. Read operations and failed instructions do not advance time.

Each accepted declaration consumes the specified quantity on one eligible permit and ships that quantity from the stated consignment. The exporter, material and destination must all match. Positive whole quantities may be split across declarations and permits. The total actually shipped cannot exceed the consignment quantity. An accepted shipment is irreversible in this service and does not generate a new quota-return event. The two already withdrawn historical declarations are the only scheduled reinstatements.

Permit charges are quantity multiplied by premium_fee_minor_per_unit. Splitting changes neither the quota total nor the charge; there is no per-declaration surcharge. Cash is debited on actual acceptance. The bank checks permit and stock availability, quantity, eligibility and cash. It does not determine whether an eligible early allocation preserves other shipment commitments or minimizes the customer's total charge. Shipment deadlines are inclusive and govern actual acceptance, not proposed or approved instructions.

Unlock `propose_licensed_shipment`, then supply case_id, action=`ship`, and data containing shipment_id, permit_id and quantity_units. The two ID fields identify service_records rows; their separate reference fields are business references. A customer-approved instruction executes one actual declaration. This service has no borrowing, quota conversion, early stock release, extra permit issuance or reversal of a newly accepted shipment operation.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_licensed_shipment`

Prepare an actual shipment declaration using one eligible quantity permit.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
